title: Multi-Turn RAG Query Rewriting:
prompt: **Multi-Turn RAG Query Rewriting:** A user asks *"How much did Apple make in Q3?"* followed by *"What about Microsoft?"*. Why will passing *"What about Microsoft?"* directly to your embedding model retrieve garbage, and how do you build a fast query-contextualization rewriter?
